etymology.historical_story: Diane is the French form of Diana and is also used as a feminine given name in English. Its pronunciation differs between those languages, so its spelling alone does not establish a Malaysian pronunciation. This name history supports a possible interpretation of the input; it does not establish diane as a standard Malay vocabulary item. Source: [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/diane).
